mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_jobs ( job_type, status, review_post_id, photo_group_id, photo_id, error_message, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{jobType}, #{status}, #{reviewPostId}, #{photoGroupId}, #{photoId}, #{errorMessage}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()), #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_type AS jobType, status, review_post_id AS reviewPostId, photo_group_id AS photoGroupId, photo_id AS photoId, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM review_jobs WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, job_type AS jobType, status, review_post_id AS reviewPostId, photo_group_id AS photoGroupId, photo_id AS photoId, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM review_jobs WHERE review_post_id = #{reviewPostId} ORDER BY id DESC
